acceptDismissed: PR #{pr} has new commits; its existing approvals were dismissed
acceptDoneAfterReturn: PR #{pr} was merged on GitHub and the batch is closed; the earlier return stays on record
acceptDoneDetail:
{url}

acceptReadyDetail:
This PR meets the project's merge rules; accepting it merges it right away.
{url}

acceptStoppedMergeUnconfirmed: The merge result of PR #{pr} cannot be confirmed yet; retry to check the repository's state
acceptStoppedNoCommits: Accept not completed: the branch has no commits
acceptStoppedNoCommitsDetail: The change under review is “{subject}”, but branch {branch} has no commits, so there is no PR to open and nothing to merge. The change may be on another branch; push it to {branch} and accept again.
acceptStoppedNoCredentials: Could not get the platform's GitHub credentials ({why})
acceptStoppedPrClosed: PR #{pr} was closed on GitHub without being merged
acceptStoppedPrOpenFailed: Accept not completed: the PR could not be opened
acceptStoppedPrOpenFailedDetail:
{reason}.

acceptStoppedPrStalled: PR #{pr} cannot move forward right now
acceptStoppedPrUnavailable: Accept not completed: the PR could not be merged
acceptStoppedPrUnavailableDetail:
{why}.
A project bound to GitHub is accepted only by merging its PR; the platform will not bypass the PR and push upstream directly. Retry the accept once this is sorted out.
acceptStoppedStatusUnread: Could not read the status of PR #{pr}: {error}
apiRetry: A request to the AI service failed; retrying
apiRetryAttempt: A request to the AI service failed; retrying (attempt {attempt})
apiRetryNoResponse: No response from the AI service: the connection failed, dropped or timed out
apiRetryNoResponseWaited: No response from the AI service after {seconds} s: the connection failed, dropped or timed out
archiveStoppedFollowing: The channel was archived; the platform stopped following PR #{pr}
archiveStoppedFollowingDetail:
{url}
This PR is not merged. The platform will not close it; someone needs to decide whether to close it.
artifactDeclared: This delivery created a new artifact, “{name}”, which the project did not have before
askAnswerUndelivered: An answer could not be delivered: the conversation that asked is gone
askAnswerUndeliveredDetail: An answer can only enter the conversation that asked the question, and that conversation is over — it will not come back. The answer was never read, and the platform has stopped retrying. To get it through, say it again as an ordinary message.
backendErrorBurst: Repeated backend error: {headline} — {count} times in {minutes} min
backendErrorBurstAt: Repeated backend error ({where}): {headline} — {count} times in {minutes} min
blockUpgradedToRoom: A message was turned into a channel
blockUpgradedToTask: A message was turned into a task
cardRedescribed: {actor} edited the review description (synced to the PR)
cardRejectedClosed: {who} sent the changes back; the original task is closed
cardRejectedFixing: {who} sent the changes back; they are being revised
cardVoidedDetail: Voided in state “{state}”. This is not a return and does not mean the checks failed; it only ends this review so the channel can submit again.{reason}
catchingUp: Catching up on what the session said while this channel was disconnected; this turn starts shortly
catchingUpDetail: It starts on its own once that is done. No need to resend.
cliModelLimitReached: This model's quota is used up
cliModelLimitReachedHint: Switch to another model, or wait for the quota to reset. Retrying will not help.
cliProviderOverloaded: The AI service is overloaded right now; this step did not finish
cliProviderOverloadedHint: This is a problem on the service's side and usually clears up quickly. You can retry later.
cliSubscriptionEgressOffline: The subscription's egress machine is offline; this step did not finish
cliSubscriptionEgressOfflineHint: The platform's Claude subscription can only reach the internet through this machine, so models on the subscription cannot be called while it is offline. Retry once it is back online, or switch to another model for now.
cliProviderUnreachable: Could not reach the AI service; this step did not finish
cliProviderUnreachableHint: This usually does not recover on its own: the tunnel helper in this environment may have disconnected, or the relay connection is unstable. Retry once; if it still cannot connect, someone needs to check the environment, so do not keep retrying.
cliResponseTruncated: The last reply was not sent in full
cliResponseTruncatedHint: The last reply may be incomplete; retrying lets it continue.
cliToolUnavailableHint: The tool is waiting for permission, but the prompt appeared in the container's terminal, where nobody in the channel can answer it. The tool setup in this environment is wrong and someone needs to check it; retrying will not change anything.
cloudStepChecking: Connecting to the environment and checking the runtime
contextCompactRunning: The conversation is too long, so the context is being compacted; work resumes afterwards, with no replies in the meantime
contextCompactSessionEnded: The session ended before compaction finished
creditsExhausted: The credits are used up, so this turn did not run
creditsExhaustedDetail: Ask the team admin, or whoever grants the allowance, to top it up.
deliveryChecking: The message was written to the session and is being checked; it will not be sent twice
deliveryFallback: The message could not reach the running session and has been queued
deliveryFallbackDetail: The message is saved and the platform will handle it from the queue. No need to resend.
dependencyActionDelivered: The target branch is now {branch}. Fetch the remote branch, rebase this task's commits onto it, resolve conflicts, rerun the checks and push. The parent may have been squash-merged, so check the patches and replay only this task's own changes; do not bring back ancestor changes the parent dropped and that have not been approved again. A clean rebase does not prove the commit range is right; check that the final diff contains only this task's delivery.
dependencyActionUndelivered: Keep the existing work and check which undelivered changes this task depends on. Following the task's requirements, decide whether to drop the dependency, implement it independently, or report why you cannot continue; do not treat a rejection or a close as merged code, and do not close the subtask automatically. To drop the dependency, rebuild this task's own commits on its branch with the project's default branch as the base, verify the diff contains none of the rejected changes, then run cheese push-fix --drop-dependency. It retargets the existing PR, clears the task dependency and old approvals; do not file the card again or merge it yourself.
dependencyHeadline: The parent task {outcome}; this subtask needs to recheck its dependencies
dependencyHistory:
Past rejections of ancestor dependencies follow. They are not the current state: read the review cards and tasks again to check which changes were withdrawn or approved later.
{items}
dependencyHistoryItem:
Past rejection reason on review card {card}:
{reason}
dependencyOutcomeReturned: was sent back and is still in progress
dependencyRejection: The parent task's latest review card {card} was rejected. {why}
deviceWaiting: Waiting for the environment to connect
dispatchUnknown: Tool calls with no result: {count}. The platform will not retry them on its own
dispatchUnknownDetail: These calls were sent, but the environment never returned a result, so only that environment knows whether they ran: {calls}. Resending them automatically could apply a change that already took effect a second time. Once you have checked, you can retry and it will continue from there.
docCommentedHandedTo: {actor} commented on the doc; handed to {seat}
environmentFailedHandedOver: Environment setup failed and was handed to General.
environmentFailedNoOverview: Environment setup failed and General can't take it right now. You can read the install log.
environmentRecoveryRequest: The channel's environment failed to prepare and was handed to General to check
environmentRepaired: Environment fixed; continuing with the earlier messages
forceMergedVerdictFailure: Merged knowing the checks were not all green
forceMergedVerdictNoChecks: No CI had run on this change at the time
forceMergedVerdictOther: The check status at the time was {state}
forceMergedVerdictPending: Merged without waiting for the checks to finish
forceMergedVerdictSuccess: The checks were in fact all green at the time
forceMergedVerdictUnread: The check status could not be read at the time
gateAbandoned: Check result lost; the review was ended
gateAbandonedNudge:
Check incomplete: the review card you filed got stuck in the platform's quality check. The platform never got the check result (the backend restarted or the check task was lost), so it ended the card; it will not reach the reviewer.

**This is not a failed check**: the check never finished, and nothing shows your code has a problem, so there is nothing to fix. Make sure the workspace is still as you delivered it, then **file the review card again**.
gateCondemned: Check incomplete; the review was ended
gateCondemnedDetail:
The platform could not get this check's result, usually because the check task was lost when the backend restarted.
This is not a failed check: the check did not finish, and nothing shows the code has a problem. Just submit the review again.
harnessNotDeployed: {harness} is not deployed in this channel's environment, so this turn did not start.
hostFailureDetail:
Failed {count} turns in a row with “{title}”.
{then}
hostUnreachable: This turn did not start: the device this channel is bound to cannot be reached.
hostUnreachableDetail: Project files and committed changes are all still there. Retry after this device reconnects. The channel will not move to another device, so its working directory and session stay consistent.
librarySavedDetail: {actor} saved {file} from this channel to the library; every channel can reference it
machineQuarantined: Computer “{name}” keeps failing and has been taken out of use
machineQuarantinedNext: The channel stays on this computer; the platform waits for it to recover and will not move to another one. Retry once the computer is back.
mailDrafted: Cheese wrote a draft in {account}; it is sent only once {owner} confirms
mcpNotConnected: {server} needs to be connected in the project settings
memoryDreamChanged: Memory cleanup: shared project memory entries changed: {count}
memoryDreamRefused: Memory cleanup was skipped this time: it would have deleted more entries than the limit allows
memoryDreamRefusedDetail: When one cleanup would delete more than half of a scope and more than 3 entries, the platform treats it as a sign that the tree broke rather than as a cleanup: nothing is written this time (no memory was lost). Record: this run in `memory_dream_runs` (run id `{run_id}`).
memoryMigrationApplied: Old memory migration: done, wrote {files} files
memoryMigrationReported: Old memory migration: report ready for review — {sources} old memories → {files} files
memoryMigrationReportedOverGoal: Old memory migration: report ready for review — {sources} old memories → {files} files; **team index over target**
memoryRefused: Some changes were overwritten by the platform's copy; reread and write again
memoryRejected: Over the length limit and not written: {count}
mentionFused: AI teammates reached this hour's limit on mentioning each other; this one did not wake anyone
mentionFusedDetail: In one channel, AI teammates' mentions can start at most {limit} turns an hour, so they cannot keep mentioning each other forever. Not woken this time: {names}. Mentions by people are not limited.
mentionUnknownMember: Could not notify {member}: not a member of this project
mergeRefusedOnAccept: Accept not completed: GitHub refused to merge PR #{pr}
mergeWithheld: The platform will not merge PR #{pr} automatically
mergeWithheldBehind: The branch keeps falling behind main (still behind after 3 automatic rebases); main may be moving too fast or the rebase is not taking effect, so a person needs to handle it
mergeWithheldBehindWhy: The platform's automatic branch updates cannot keep up with main.
mergeWithheldCheckMissing: The required check {checks} has never run (waited more than {minutes} minutes); the workflow may not have triggered, or was renamed or disabled, and the platform will not decide on anyone's behalf that it can be skipped
mergeWithheldCheckMissingWhy: The check did not fail; it never reported at all. The platform can only confirm that nobody ran it, not decide for anyone that it need not run.
mergeWithheldVotes: Merge-when-green is armed, but there are not enough approvals ({votes}/{required})
mergeWithheldVotesWhy: The rules are met, but the arming person's vote alone does not reach the number of approvals the project requires.
messageUndeliveredStale: Message not delivered after waiting {minutes} min
messageUndeliveredStaleDetail: Nothing shows the message arrived. It has waited too long for an automatic resend to still make sense. To continue, retry; the earlier messages go along with it.
migrationCollision: Another change awaiting review also adds a database migration
migrationCollisionDetail:
The other change is in: {rooms}.
Each change carries its own alembic revision; once both merge, the migration chain forks, which usually also means the same thing was done twice.
The platform will not block this accept. Compare the two changes first: if they really are two different things, accept as usual, and after the first one merges the other needs a rebase.
noFirstOutput: This turn produced no output within {seconds} s. The platform will not retry on its own.
noFirstOutputDetail: No model output and no tool call within {seconds} s, so the environment is treated as never having started. Common causes: an expired model subscription credential (re-authenticate on the host), a container that could not be created, a full disk, or no connection to the model. The task never started, so there are no finished changes. The platform will not retry on its own, because a retry would hit the same environment. Someone needs to check the environment (container, disk, model connection); retry once it is fixed.
policyProposal: {actor} wants to use {what} “{label}”, above this project's allowed tiers ({tier}); this step waits for {approver} to approve.
prClosed: PR #{pr} was closed without merging; the review is void
prClosedDetail:
The PR was closed on GitHub without being merged, so the platform voided this review and will not merge it. To keep delivering, submit a new review.
{url}
prConflict: PR #{pr} conflicts with its target branch
prMergedDelivered: PR #{pr} was merged in the repository; the task is delivered
prMergedExternally: was merged by hand on GitHub (not by the platform)
prReviewCapped: Review on PR #{pr} has gone back and forth {limit} times; a person needs to step in
promptReplayed: These messages ({count}) have now gone into a turn {attempt} times, and the earlier attempts did not finish{oldest}.
promptReplayedOldestImage: ; the oldest is an image from [{author}]
promptUndelivered: This turn did not start: the message never reached the session, and the session did not respond.
promptUndeliveredDetail: This is not an AI service problem; the request never reached the model. The message was sent to the claude session in the environment, but the session did not take it. Usually the session is stuck on a screen waiting for an answer, or its terminal has closed. Files in the workspace and finished changes are unaffected. Retrying reopens the session; if it happens several times in a row, forward this notice to an admin.
resendAfterDeploy: A platform deploy interrupted the last turn before the message arrived; it has been sent again
resendAfterToolsLost: The platform tools disconnected during the last turn and its reply never reached the channel; reconnected and sent again
resendInterrupted: A platform restart interrupted the last resend; the message was not delivered
resendInterruptedDetail: A message is resent only once, never in an automatic loop. Finished changes are all in the workspace; to continue, retry and it will pick up where it stopped.
roomArchivedWithParent: Channel “{room}” was archived along with its parent channel “{parent}”
roomUnarchived: {actor} unarchived channel “{room}”; it is active again
routineProposed: Cheese drafted “{title}”; it runs only once you confirm
runnerUnresponsive: {harness}'s runner has not answered for {seconds} s
runtimeImageMissing: This turn did not start. The platform is preparing the environment again.
runtimeImageMissingDetail: This turn had not started running, and project files are untouched. Retry in a moment; if it keeps happening, contact an admin.
runtimeImageMissingTitle: The environment's image is temporarily unavailable
sessionStartDockerUnavailable: Docker in the environment is not running or cannot be reached
sessionStartExecutorFailed: the execution container could not be created
sessionStartExecutorImageMissing: the environment is missing the execution container's image
sessionStartExecutorNameTaken: the previous execution container has not been cleaned up yet
sessionStartModelLogin: the model service login has expired; an admin needs to sign in again
sessionStartPlatformCredential: the platform did not accept this session's credential
sessionStartPlatformError: the platform returned an error during startup
sessionStartProgramBroken: a program in the environment cannot run; it may be damaged or built for another platform
sessionStartProgramCannotRun: {name} in the environment cannot run; it may be damaged or built for another platform
sessionStartProgramMissing: the environment is missing a program it needs
sessionStartRunnerBusy: this channel's previous session process has not exited yet
sessionStartTimeout: it did not come up within the wait limit; the startup log is in the activity view
sessionStartUnknown: the cause was not recognised; the startup log is in the activity view
sessionStartWorkMachineOffline: this channel's environment is not connected
sessionStartWorkMachinePreparing: this channel's environment is still being prepared
sessionStartWorkMachineRefused: could not get this channel's environment
sessionStartWorkMachineUnbound: the computer chosen for this channel has been unbound; choose an environment again
sessionStartingMessageQueued: The session in the environment is starting; the message is waiting and will be sent automatically
storageExhausted: The environment is out of disk space. This turn is paused while the platform cleans up.
storageExhaustedDetail: Project files and finished changes are all still there. Retry once the cleanup is done; if it keeps happening, contact an admin.
storageExhaustedTitle: The environment is out of disk space
subagentStopEmpty: A subagent handed back a result (with no message)
subscriptionCredentialExpired: This turn did not start: the model subscription credential has expired and needs re-authentication.
subscriptionCredentialExpiredDetail: Someone with access to the device needs to re-authenticate on it (claude setup-token, or restore .credentials.json). This is not a container, disk or network problem, and the task never started, so there are no finished changes. Retrying will not help; once the credential is renewed, the next message is handled normally.
subscriptionCredentialExpiredTitle: The model subscription credential has expired
timedDelivery: You asked the platform to hand you this at this time
toolsRecovered: The platform tools disconnected and the last reply never reached the channel; reconnected and resending now
toolsRecoveredDetail: It is resent only once. The last turn's reply stayed in the working session and never reached the channel.
turnCrashed: This turn stopped unexpectedly. The platform will not retry on its own
turnCrashedDetail: Finished changes are all still there. A failure like this is usually a platform bug that a retry could trigger again, so the platform will not retry on its own. Someone needs to read the logs to find the problem; once it is fixed, retry and it will pick up where it stopped.
turnFailedOutOfCredit: This turn did not finish: the AI relay balance is used up
turnFailedOutOfCreditHint: Top up the balance, or switch to another AI service. Retrying will not help.
turnLimit: This turn hit its time limit and was stopped.
turnLimitDetail: This is not an error from the AI service; the turn did not finish within its time limit. Usually a command never returned, or the session is stuck on a screen waiting for an answer. Finished changes are all in the workspace. Retrying picks up where it stopped; if the same work keeps timing out, split it into smaller pieces.
turnLimitTitle: This turn hit its time limit and was stopped
turnQueued: The project is running as many turns as it can at once; this turn is queued
turnQueuedBehind: The project is running as many turns as it can at once; this turn is queued, {ahead} ahead of it
turnQueuedHostBusy: The platform is busy; this turn is queued
turnQueuedHostBusyDetail: It starts on its own once resources free up. No need to resend.
turnQueuedDetail: It starts on its own once the turns ahead finish. No need to resend.
turnResent: The platform resent the previous turn's message
turnTimeoutDetail: The session has gone quiet; the screen subscription still receives any further output.
turnWedged: The last turn produced no output for {minutes} min and was stopped
turnWedgedDetail: Finished changes are all in the workspace. The platform will not retry on its own, because a retry would go back to the environment that just failed. Once someone has checked it, you can retry and it will pick up where it stopped.
workLeftClosedTask: {line} (finished task; its files are still on the old computer)
workLeftOnMachine: Switched environments; files from some finished tasks could not be backed up and remain only on the old computer
workspaceVcsPerms: This turn did not start: the workspace repository has the wrong permissions.
workspaceVcsPermsDetail: The repository directory belongs to another system user, so the platform cannot access it. Project files, committed changes and history are unaffected. An admin needs to change the owner once on the machine (deploy/fix-workspace-ownership.sh); the platform cannot do it by itself. Forward this notice to an admin and retry once it is fixed.
workspaceVcsPermsTitle: Wrong permissions on the workspace repository
pushNotice: A new notice from the platform
pushAway: {count} new notifications while you were away
sandboxReplaced: Preparing the environment failed; preparing it again
sandboxLost: The machine the environment was on stopped answering, so the environment was replaced: the new one starts from what is pushed to the repository, and changes that were not pushed are gone
sandboxRestoring: Restoring the environment from its archive
sandboxAsleep: The environment went to sleep after {minutes} minutes without activity. Its files are kept, and the next message wakes it.
sandboxStoppedNoCredits: Credits ran out, so the environment was stopped. Its files are kept, and once there are credits again the next message wakes it.
sandboxArchiveLost: The environment's archive is gone, so it starts again from what is pushed to the repository
cloudVmReplaced: Preparing the cloud VM failed; preparing it again
cloudVmReleasedIdle: The cloud VM was idle for {minutes} minutes. Its changes were pushed to their branches and it was released; the next message prepares a new one.
sandboxFailingNext: The channel stays where it is and won't move elsewhere on its own. Someone needs to check the connector and the session in this environment; retry once it is fixed.
